method: Visual frames and on-screen text only. Timestamps are seek points, not event boundaries. Incomplete text is summarized. Kysup is the recording’s player-selected name.

locations.placementEvidence: Interior exit opens onto an east–west stone path. Exterior at 666s is a candidate for the house, not a confirmed match.
observations: Wreath explains the five-item/familiar entry limit, suggests selling at the general store, and offers item storage.
A wake-up scene shows Koh in bed and Weedy inside. Wreath later thanks someone for waking him.
visibleLines: If you’re not taking items to the tower, you can always leave them with me.

locations.placementEvidence: At 386s the route passes a hedge-fronted stone facade near a paved intersection. The shop opens by 394s. The exact entrance and plot are unresolved.
observations: Master refers to familiars from Koh’s father. Selling opens a stock list and a price offer.
The selected sale offer in this visit is 400G. The choices are accept, mistake, and decline.
visibleLines: Have you come again to bother me? Go home, go home!

locations.placementEvidence: Interior has a red carpet, a recessed brick alcove, and symmetrical foreground fixtures. Exterior not confirmed.
observations: The choice tree offers advice on love life, fighting, and enjoying life. Shiela asks whether Koh likes animals and whether he feels an urge to use magic.
Fighting advice emphasizes choosing weapons based on who Koh is fighting.

locations.placementEvidence: At 506s Koh leaves a low weathered building; the 514s interior title explicitly reads Blacksmith. The earlier exterior alone does not prove the Blacksmith plot.
observations: Barry works behind a counter with shelves and red and blue pots. Buy, sell, and look-around are separate choices.
Barry says he started looking after the store at fifteen.
visibleLines: I was fifteen when I started looking after this store.

locations.placementEvidence: The stone-front entrance at 562s has a blue pot and low flanking walls; Fur is at the counter immediately afterward.
observations: Fur opens a selling interface with item prices, wallet total, and item description. Pita is shown at 5G in this sale list.
The Pita description says it restores 5 MP to a familiar.

locations.placementEvidence: Low dark roof, round wall ornaments, and a central door facing a broad paved approach. At 642s, a blue cross banner is visible by a paved junction.
observations: Hush says a patient could not be saved because he lacked equipment. A later prompt offers a 15G payment with confirm and cancel choices. The purpose of that payment needs the preceding text.

uiObservations.observation: Home storage displays two side-by-side item lists, a wallet readout, and a lower description panel.
Shop sale view shows selected stock, individual prices, a money readout, and a separate dialogue panel.
Blacksmith menu uses a highlighted text row and presents buy, sell, and browsing options in one dialogue panel.

mappingLimits: Named capture links identify matching or candidate building models. The recording does not expose the 128x128 tile coordinates. Comparing raw interior-capture tile IDs to the outdoor grid did not establish exact matches. No plot or runtime placement changes were made.
scopeNote: The first Tower segment shows combat on a floor labeled 2F in this save. The footage records that observation only and does not override the project’s explicit monster-free floor 2 rule.
